message.content:
High-contrast denim jacket, straight-cut mid-wash blue, knee-length hem, crisp cotton twill.
Slim-fit jeans, tapered ankle, dark indigo color #191970, durable stretch denim with subtle texture.
White ribbed-knit crewneck sweater, relaxed fit with dropped shoulders, soft merino wool blend.
Chunky leather sneakers, white upper with gum sole, medium top-down height, smooth calfskin leather.
Minimalist silver pendant necklace, 18mm oval link chain, polished sterling silver.
Tinted round-frame sunglasses, tortoise-shell acetate, dark grey lenses for sunny autumn light.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance between relaxed comfort and intentional style for a first date in the park. The classic jean-on-jeans combination adheres to her specific wish while the contrasting white sweater and denim jacket add visual interest against the autumn foliage. Footwear is kept practical yet polished with chunky leather sneakers that handle outdoor terrain without sacrificing elegance. Finally, accessories like the silver pendant and sunglasses add a touch of personality suitable for daylight hours without feeling overdressed.
